candidates.basis: NL3; source:state:SearchState.Intercepted; source:state:FormationAdjustment; state:Intercepted:line:14; state:FormationAdjustment:line:38; complete closed transition inventory.
candidates.expected: A closed-model transition from Intercepted to FormationAdjustment, selected by the interception event, must exist.
candidates.observed: The closed inventory has Intercepted -> NoIntercept on Intercept_Resolved and an outer SearchState -> FormationAdjustment transition guarded by R45RouteToken == 9; it has no direct Intercepted -> FormationAdjustment transition.
candidates.reason: The exact source state Intercepted is present, but the closed transition inventory contains no Intercepted-to-FormationAdjustment edge. The existing Intercepted transition goes to NoIntercept, while the source transition is represented through a different SearchState routing structure; the required endpoint pair is therefore absent from the complete closed inventory.
candidates.requirement_quote: When the UAV swarm is intercepted, it transitions to the formation adjustment state.
candidates.strongest_rebuttal: The closed model may implement the source-level relation through compiler-generated routing from Intercepted to SearchState and then FormationAdjustment, but the supplied inventory does not provide an exact complete macro closure proving that this routed path is the required direct endpoint relation.
candidates.title: Intercept response targets the wrong state

candidates.basis: NL4; source:state:SearchState; source:state:AttackState; source:transition:tr_0011; transition:line:41; event-consumer facts for Task_Assignment_Received.
candidates.expected: During flight, receipt of Task_Assignment_Received must produce the SearchState-to-AttackState relation.
candidates.observed: The closed transition is SearchState -> AttackState with guard R45RouteToken == 11 and no trigger; Task_Assignment_Received is consumed by child-state routing transitions to the composite completion pseudo-state rather than by the exact outer carrier.
candidates.reason: The source requires flight to enter AttackState on task assignment. The closed model contains the exact SearchState-to-AttackState transition and the complete event-consumer inventory shows task-assignment consumers in all SearchState child states, but the transition itself has no trigger and uses a route-token guard instead of the required event response at the source-level carrier.
candidates.requirement_quote: During flight, if task assignment information is received, it enters the attack state.
candidates.strongest_rebuttal: The compiler may intentionally lower the event response into child transitions that set R45RouteToken before the outer guarded transition; the supplied closed inventory confirms the endpoint but does not prove that this lowering is semantically equivalent to the unqualified source event relation.
candidates.title: Task assignment response targets the wrong state

candidates.basis: NL4; source:transition:tr_0012; source:state:AttackState; transition:line:45; event-consumer fact for Attack_Complete_Decrease_UAV_Count; closed transition effects=[]; variable R45RouteToken is only reset on the completion transition.
candidates.expected: The AttackState completion transition must apply an effect that decreases the number of UAVs in the swarm.
locus_names: number of UAVs in the swarm
candidates.observed: AttackState -> SearchState on Attack_Complete_Decrease_UAV_Count has an empty effects list; no UAV-count variable or decrement effect is supplied on that carrier.
candidates.reason: The exact AttackState completion transition is present and consumes Attack_Complete_Decrease_UAV_Count, but its parsed effects are empty. The closed model therefore lacks the required effect that decreases the number of UAVs after attack completion.
candidates.requirement_quote: After completing the attack, the number of UAVs in the swarm decreases accordingly.
candidates.strongest_rebuttal: The event name includes a decrease phrase, but the typed closed transition effect inventory is empty and no supplied variable inventory defines an equivalent UAV-count update.
candidates.title: Attack completion lacks the required UAV-count decrease effect

cardinality_bindings.reason: The source structure explicitly contains concurrent region partitions under SearchState, so the typed primary domain is concurrent_regions. The owner is the enclosing SearchState rather than an individual child state.
